_comment: V12 SATELLITE ENGINE — the curated birds sats.json is built from (docs/v12/SATELLITE-ENGINE.md §6). Checked 2026-11-19 (beta90 additions 2026-11-21: AO-7 Mode B beacon + mode names, ISS 437.550 SSTV events, SONATE-2 SSTV 145.880, TO-108, AO-73 fc-bpsk / MO-122 fox-bpsk — docs/v12/SATELLITE-BEST.md 1.5) against AMSAT's live FM and Live Linear Satellites pages, CelesTrak's amateur + weather groups and SatNOGS. The server's built-in copy for a first boot offline is curatedCatalogue() in android/app/src/main/cpp/vibe_sat_engine.h — test-sat-engine §9 fails if the two drift. 'follow': 'mode' = SatNOGS may move this downlink (Meteor's frequency and mode change on orbit, brief §6.2 TRAP). Catalogue numbers are plain integers up to 9 digits (OMM), never 5-digit TLE fields.
_labelGroups: ★★ beta91 SATELLITE LABELS (docs/v12/SAT-LABELS.md): CelesTrak groups whose birds are LABEL-ONLY — named on the waterfall at their Doppler-shifted downlink, never offered in SATELLITE mode, never decoded (ORBCOMM is commercial messaging: a label, nothing else). Asked AFTER the main groups in the same round (one more URL; the same stop-on-non-200 rules), and their fetch time is kept apart (labelOrbits) so the orbit data's age is the main groups'. Every bird of the group up to `max`; the transmitter's mode is 'label', which a server older than beta91 skips (a bird with no usable downlink is not offered).
